# Making Variables Factor
```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender <- as.factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender)
MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone <- as.factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone)

MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender <- recode_factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Gender, `0` = "Female", `1` = "Male")
MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone<- recode_factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$Has_Phone, `0` = "No Phone", `1` = "Phone")

MegaAnalysisMaster$ParadigmsCombined_Factor <- recode_factor(MegaAnalysisMaster$ParadigmsCombined, `1` = "Tech Directions", `2` = "Tech Restraunt", `3` = "Waiting Alone", `4` = "Waiting Together", `5` = "Parent Study", `6` = "Lunch Study")

MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs <- subset(MegaAnalysisMaster, Gender == "Female" | Gender == "Male")

MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs <- subset(MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs, Has_Phone == "No Phone"|  Has_Phone == "Phone")


TechDirections_Tight$Gender <- as.factor(TechDirections_Tight$Gender)
TechDirections_Tight$Has_Phone <- as.factor(TechDirections_Tight$Has_Phone)
TechDirections_Tight$Gender <- recode_factor(TechDirections_Tight$Gender, `0` = "Female", `1` = "Male")
TechDirections_Tight$Has_Phone<- recode_factor(TechDirections_Tight$Has_Phone, `0` = "No Phone", `1` = "Phone")


```


```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster_TechDirections <- subset(MegaAnalysisMaster, ParadigmsCombined == 1)
MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs_WithoutTechDirections <- subset(MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs, ParadigmsCombined != 1)
```


# Emotional Valence

## Initial Model

```{r}
contrasts(MegaAnalysisMaster$ParadigmsCombined_Factor) = contr.sum(6)

EmoInitial <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~Age + Has_Phone*Gender +Has_Phone*ParadigmsCombined_Factor, MegaAnalysisMaster)
summary(EmoInitial)
```



```{r}
lm.beta::lm.beta(EmoInitial)
```

```{r}
confint(EmoInitial)
```


### Tech Directions
#### Model 1 - Phone Only 
```{r}
TechDirect_LM.1 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone, TechDirections_Tight)
summary(TechDirect_LM.1)
```

```{r}
confint(TechDirect_LM.1)
```

```{r}
lm.beta::lm.beta(TechDirect_LM.1)
```



#### Model 2 - Phone + Gender + Age 
```{r}
TechDirect_LM.2 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone + Gender + Age, TechDirections_Tight)
summary(TechDirect_LM.2)
```


```{r}
confint(TechDirect_LM.2)
```

```{r}
lm.beta::lm.beta(TechDirect_LM.2)
```

#### Model 3 - Phone + Gender + Age 
```{r}
TechDirect_LM.3 <- lm(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone * Gender + Age, TechDirections_Tight)
summary(TechDirect_LM.3)
```


```{r}
confint(TechDirect_LM.3)
```

```{r}
lm.beta::lm.beta(TechDirect_LM.3)
```

##### Simple Effects
```{r}
TechDirect_EMM_Int <- emmeans(TechDirect_LM.3, "Has_Phone", by = "Gender") #, mode = "satterthwaite")
TechDirect_EMM_Int
```


```{r}
contrast(TechDirect_EMM_Int)
```


```{r}

TechDirect_EMM_Int <- emmeans(TechDirect_LM.3, "Gender", by = "Has_Phone") #, mode = "satterthwaite")
TechDirect_EMM_Int
contrast(TechDirect_EMM_Int)
```


```{r}
print(eff_size(TechDirect_EMM_Int, sigma = sigma(TechDirect_LM.3), edf = df.residual(TechDirect_LM.3)))
```


```{r}
pairs(TechDirect_EMM_Int)
```

## Multi-Level Models

### Without Tech Directions
#### Model 1 - Phone Only 
```{r}
EmoVal_wo_TechDirect <- lme(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ 1 + Has_Phone ,   #Fixed effects portion of model
                        data = MegaAnalysisMasterGraphs_WithoutTechDirections, #Which data to use
                        random = ~ 1 + Has_Phone| ParadigmsCombined, #Random effects portion of model
                        method="REML", #Estimation method
                        na.action="na.omit") #missing data handling
summary(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)
```


```{r}
tab_model(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect, digits = 3, digits.re = 5)
```

```{r}
lme.dscore(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect, MegaAnalysisMaster,type = "nlme")
```

```{r}
sigma(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)
```

```{r}
r.squaredGLMM(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)
```

```{r}
VarCorr(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)
```



```{r}

intervals(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect, which = "fixed")
 
```


```{r}
reghelper::ICC(EmoVal_wo_TechDirect)

ICC1.lme(SocialConnection_Std, ParadigmsCombined, data = MegaAnalysisMaster)
ICC1.lme(SocialConnection_Std, Has_Phone, data = MegaAnalysisMaster)
```

# Values for Forest Plot
The values will be reversed as the phone condition is labeled Phone to No Phone but the effect we are interested is from No Phone to Phone. This means the values shown are the opposite sign than reported, i.e. -.18 is actually .18. 

## Affect Valence

### Getting Directions
```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster %>%
  filter(ParadigmsCombined == 1) %>%
    cohens_d(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone, data = .) 
```

### Parents with Children
```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster %>%
  filter(ParadigmsCombined == 5) %>%
    cohens_d(Emotional_Valance_Std ~ Has_Phone, data = .) 
```

```{r}
MegaAnalysisMaster %>%
  filter(ParadigmsCombined == 2) %>%
```
